 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # retain the matching reference shape below and place the rightmost colored
    # figure directly above it, centered on the reference's horizontal center.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    ref = next((r,c) for r in range(divider+1,h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0)
    color = grid[ref[0]][ref[1]]
    coords=[]
    for r in range(divider):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] not in (0, color, 5):
                coords.append((r,c,grid[r][c]))
    # identify rightmost object and translate its bounding-box center to ref center
    chosen_color=max(grid[r][c] for r,c,_ in coords)
    pts=[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in coords if v==chosen_color]
    minr=min(r for r,c,v in pts); minc=min(c for r,c,v in pts)
    maxr=max(r for r,c,v in pts); maxc=max(c for r,c,v in pts)
    # template shape is copied as-is; selected figure is centered in its width above it
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(9)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r>divider and grid[r][c] != 0:
                out[5+(r-(divider+1))][c]=grid[r][c]
    target_center=(min(c for r,c in [(rr,cc) for rr in range(divider+1,h) for cc in range(w) if grid[rr][cc]!=0])+max(c for rr in range(divider+1,h) for c in range(w) if grid[rr][c]!=0))/2
    source_center=(minc+maxc)/2
    dr=2-minr
    dc=round(target_center-source_center)
    for r,c,v in pts:
        rr=r+dr; cc=c+dc
        if 0<=rr<5 and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out

    div=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x==row[0] for x in row) and row[0]==5)
    bottom=[(r,c) for r in range(div+1,h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
    br0=min(r for r,c in bottom); br1=max(r for r,c in bottom)
    bc0=min(c for r,c in bottom); bc1=max(c for r,c in bottom)
    # rightmost object above divider is the figure to relocate
    color=max(grid[r][c] for r in range(div) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,5))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(div) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
